steps.prompt_exact: Build me a phone-friendly one-file HTML offer rescue desk I can save and use offline: I want to enter a small business offer, note symptoms and objections, score proof, price, urgency, and risk, then get prioritized fixes I can copy as a short action plan.
steps.response_summary: ChatGPT returned a single self-contained HTML file for an Offer Rescue Desk with editable offer inputs, symptom chips, objection entry/removal, proof/price/urgency/risk sliders, prioritized rescue cards, an action-plan tab, local save/reset behavior, copy, and TXT/JSON export controls.
